mapper.insert: insert into batch.expected_work_occurrence (tenant_id, calendar_code, biz_date, workflow_definition_id, source_type, source_key, expected_at, due_at, generation) values (#{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}, #{bizDate}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceKey}, #{expectedAt}, #{dueAt}, 1) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code, workflow_definition_id, source_type, source_key, biz_date, generation) do nothing

insert into batch.expected_work_occurrence (tenant_id, calendar_code, biz_date, workflow_definition_id, source_type, source_key, expected_at, due_at, occurrence_status, generation) select current.tenant_id, current.calendar_code, current.biz_date, current.workflow_definition_id, current.source_type, current.source_key, current.expected_at, current.due_at, 'EXPECTED', current.generation + 1 from batch.expected_work_occurrence current where current.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and current.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and current.biz_date = #{bizDate} and current.occurrence_status = 'CANCELLED' and current.generation = ( select max(latest.generation) from batch.expected_work_occurrence latest where latest.tenant_id = current.tenant_id and latest.calendar_code = current.calendar_code and latest.biz_date = current.biz_date and latest.workflow_definition_id = current.workflow_definition_id and latest.source_type = current.source_type and latest.source_key = current.source_key) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code, workflow_definition_id, source_type, source_key, biz_date, generation) do nothing
mapper.update: update batch.expected_work_occurrence set missing_input_alerted_at = #{alertedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and occurrence_status = 'EXPECTED' and missing_input_alerted_at is null
